construction: within-sector (Date,Sector) z-score of canonical value/quality/momentum base factors, equal-weight composite. Firm-specific signal isolated by removing sector mean (sector beta / cross-industry comparability noise). Contrast = same base factors composited market-wide.
sector_source: RAWDATA Sector column (QuantiWise/internal, KSI Level-1, 27 sectors, 96.8% non-NA). Slow-moving classification, PIT-safe at sig_date. NOTE: QMJ factor-DB had Sector=NA; RAWDATA is the gold source.

factor_specs.formula: factor-DB composite value z-score, then within (Date,Sector) re-z-score
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Cross-industry P/E and book multiples are not comparable (banks vs software trade at structurally different multiples). Within-sector value ranking isolates relative mispricing from sector-level valuation regimes.

factor_specs.formula: gross profits / assets z-score, then within (Date,Sector) re-z-score
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Gross profitability margins differ structurally across industries (software ~80% vs retail ~20%); raw cross-sectional GPA is partly a sector proxy. Within-sector GPA isolates firm-level operating quality.

factor_specs.formula: 12-1 month return z-score, then within (Date,Sector) re-z-score
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Market-wide momentum is partly sector rotation (an industry-level signal). Within-sector momentum isolates firm-specific relative-strength, reducing crowded sector-momentum exposure.

measurement.metric_type_authoritative: canonical_screen (canonical_screen_bt, top-25 EW long-only, contract build_benchmark_compare NW lag-3). NOT proxy hand-calc. forge build_bt_result remains admission-binding authority.

finding: 이 구성(within-sector z-score of value/quality/momentum, top-25 EW long-only)에서 sector-relative ranking은 market-wide baseline 대비 canonical portfolio-alpha t를 2.379 -> 3.424로 개선(net_sr 0.578 -> 0.811). N=238m lockbox. rank-IC는 오히려 하락(0.0291 -> 0.0229)하나 long-only 실현 alpha(portfolio-alpha t)는 상승 — Cycle 2 교훈(rank-IC와 portfolio-alpha t 괴리) 재현. active-return cor vs STR_1715 = 0.528 (port gross cor 0.852, beta 0.965). TO 7.0/yr < 11. DSR honest(n_trials=22) = 0.947 > 0.5.
honest_caveats: RF-A3 유형: E3(2020-2023) rank-IC = -0.004 (최근 era 횡단면 IC 약화). portfolio-alpha t는 전기간 강하나 최근 순위력 decay 관찰 — 일반화 금지.
return_cor(port) 0.852 / beta 0.965: long-only top-25는 시장 1st eigenmode 제거 불가(measurement-graduation 6 확립 진실 정합). active cor 0.528가 직교 측정치 — BAB/VALUE 0.76-0.78 대비 개선이나 완전 직교 아님.
rank-IC 0.0229 < 0.04 (advisory hurdle 미달). v8.x WS2 재설계로 rank-IC advisory, portfolio-alpha t(3.424)가 hard gate 권위 — 통과.
verdict/공간폐쇄 금지: 본 결과는 이 구성(N=238, 3-factor within-sector EW top-25)에서의 실측. 다른 base factor set / horizon / cap-tier 미탐색.

challenge_flags.note: E3 2020-2023 rank-IC negative (-0.004) — recent era cross-sectional IC decay. portfolio-alpha t remains strong full-window.
